h: Nkechi Blessing and Queen Mercy Atang clash over a would-be suitor
p: Actress Nkechi Blessing has accused BBNaija star Queen Mercy Atang of telling a man who liked her that she was already in a relationship. Queen replied that she respects the actress but should have been contacted privately.
body: Nollywood actress Nkechi Blessing Sunday and Big Brother Naija star Queen Mercy Atang are at odds after the actress publicly accused Queen of discouraging a man who was interested in her.

In an Instagram video posted on 27 November 2026, Nkechi said she met a man at an eatery in Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, who told her he had wanted to get her attention but was unsure about messaging her. She said the man explained that he knew Queen and had asked her about the actress, and that Queen told him Nkechi was already in a relationship.
Nkechi questioned why Queen would say that without checking with her first, and called her a bad person.
Queen responded that she loves and respects Nkechi, whom she called her big sister, but said bringing her online was off limits and that the actress should have contacted her privately.
The exchange has drawn plenty of attention and mixed reactions from fans, with some backing the actress and others saying the matter should have been settled privately.
more: Nkechi says Queen told the man she was taken.
Queen says it should have been settled privately.
Fans are split over the row.
